verdicts.reason: A reads left to right (logo, headline and subcopy, three readable price cards in the original order, then the CTA). But the headline is small for its role, the cards and CTA nearly touch the strip of legal text that runs along the bottom edge, and the right edge is cramped. B has a strong headline, but the price cards are shrunk until their labels and units can't be read, and they're in the wrong order (6, 80, 48), so the highlighted Yearly plan loses its centre spot. The subcopy and legal text are also squeezed into a right-hand column, where the fine print is about as big as the supporting copy and jammed against the edge.
